title: ids.lock.yml: stable ids and the engine numbers the build assigned them, schema v0
description: Written by the build, kept in git. A number once given to an id is never given to another, so rebuilding a map keeps its event, door and sector numbers and saves see the same layout where nothing changed.

sectors.description: Room id to BLV sector index.

events.description: Event id to map event number.

containers.description: Chest id to loot container number.

cogs.description: Object id to face cog number (for texture and facet changes).

map_vars.description: Variable name to map variable index.

lights.description: Light id to the number `evt.SetLight` switches it by (the BLV light's id): the lights that a wiring event's `lights_on` or `lights_off` names, and the lights that start dark (`on: false`). Lights that are never switched have no number. A light that pulses (`pulse`) is switched by 40000 plus its number. In an overlay project: the base scene's pulsing lights by their key (`light:k<key>`) and the overlay's own from 49001; the key is the number `evt.SetLight` switches them by.

sounds.description: Sound id to the scene's key of the placed sound (a script switches it by the map variable `AmbientSound<key>`). In an overlay project: the base scene's ambient sounds by their key (`sound:a<key>`) and the overlay's own from 60001.

decorations.description: Decoration id to its number in the built map: the entity index `evt.SetSprite` changes its picture by. Not kept: written anew by every build in the order of objects.yml `decorations` (so a decoration added before another moves the other's number); the wiring effect `set_sprite` names the decoration by its id and needs none of this, a Lua text looks it up here.

destructibles.description: Destructible id to the scene's destructible id (the number `evt.DestroyDestructible` and `evt.DamageDestructible` take). An overlay project's are the base map's (`destructible:k<id>`) and its own from 60001.

water.description: An overlay project's base water volumes: id to the volume's place in the base scene's `water_volumes` (from 0).

spawns.description: An overlay project's base spawn points: id to the spawn's index in the base map.

ladders.description: An overlay project's base ladders: id (`ladder:<name>`, the scene's ladder id in lower case) to the ladder's place in the base scene's `ladders` (from 0). Written by `oymap import`; a change or removal names one by it (objects.yml scene.changes, scene.removals).

cinematics.description: An overlay project's base map's cinematics: id (`cinematic:<name>`, the name in the map's <stem>.cinematics.yml) to its place in that file (from 0). Written by `oymap import`. A wiring.yml cinematic of that id replaces the shipped one (the game merges a cinematics overlay by name); an overlay's events may play one by it ({cinematic: cinematic:<name>}).
